title: Hackers reportedly breach US air force’s flagship cloud computing platform
summary_full: Intrusion into Cloud One platform could jeopardize security of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics dataHackers are reported to have breached the US air force’s flagship cloud computing platform, a break-in that comes days after reports that a CIA database was accessed.Reuters reported on Friday that the intrusion into the USAF’s Cloud One platform could jeopardize the security of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.
